# Patrick Ngenzi – Security Analyst

Patrick Ngenzi is a Security Analyst (identity, cloud and network security) based in North Bay, Ontario, Canada, with 6+ years in IT and security since February 2020. He currently works as an IT System Specialist at Near North District School Board.

Certifications: Microsoft SC-300 (Identity and Access Administrator Associate), CompTIA Security+, Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate, IBM Microsoft Windows Defender and Firewall. In progress: Microsoft SC-200.

Target roles: Security / SOC Analyst, Network Security Analyst, IAM Specialist, Security Engineer. Open to Ontario-wide roles, remote, hybrid or on-site, and relocation.
